outcome: umbilical venous and arterial blood gases
cohort: 120 parturients undergoing elective cesarean section under combined spinal-epidural anesthesia.
finding: The combination of a fixed-rate infusion of noradrenaline with colloid co-administration was the most effective strategy for preventing hypotension during elective cesarean section under regional anesthesia, ensuring maternal hemodynamic stability and a favorable metabolic profile in newborns.
